data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isolda total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

in_hebrew.name: אסתולה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The goddess of the forest, derived from the Hebrew word 'eshel' (booth, wood) and 'tola' (dew).

in_greek.name: Ισολδη
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse 'Island' (island) and 'Odin' (god). In Greek, it can be interpreted as 'Isle of God' or 'Isle of the Goddess Isis'.

in_latin.name: Isolda
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'Isen' (ice) and 'hild' (battle). In Latin, it can be interpreted as 'Goddess of the Forest' or 'Goddess of the Ice Battles'.
